top_insights: VALUE PROPOSITION: Clear ROI messaging is vital for foodpanda when targeting restaurent owners, and cloud kitchens, any demographics above 15 years.
ONBOARDING FRICTION: Minimizing time-to-first-value is the primary determinant of long-term adoption across cohorts.
PRICING MODEL: Cohorts express reluctance toward aggressive upfront commitments without hands-on trial periods.
DIFFERENTIATION: Focus core messaging on resolving specific bottlenecks rather than broad feature lists.
